item.title: Ep 87: Show notes only episode
item.content:encoded: In this episode our guest explains how they standardized make-ready scopes across 40 properties. They recommend a fixed checklist for every turn, photo documentation before and after, and scheduling vendors the day notice is given rather than the day the resident moves out. The key is to start the turn process on notice day. They also share mistakes to avoid when bidding paint and flooring contracts across a portfolio.
